policy: Grid Watch automated layers ingest only sources with an explicit open-data licence or public-domain dedication. Proprietary directories and unlicensed council scraping are excluded.

sources.name: Postcodes.io
sources.licence: MIT software; underlying GB postcode data uses OS OpenData and listed open/public statistical datasets
sources.coverage_note: Northern Ireland postcode data carries separate ONSPD/LPS terms; Grid Watch only uses the public lookup response transiently for user searches and does not redistribute a postcode database.

sources.name: Planning Data (MHCLG)
sources.coverage_note: National specification remains in development; authority coverage is not complete.

sources.name: Improvement Service Spatial Hub
sources.coverage_note: Official planning application dataset; all Scottish planning authorities supply data according to the publisher.

sources.name: OpenDataNI / Department for Infrastructure
sources.coverage_note: Validated annual dataset; less current than a live planning portal.

sources.name: Wikidata
sources.coverage_note: Only used when an OSM feature carries an explicit Wikidata identifier. Missing ownership stays unknown.

sources.name: Ofgem
sources.licence: Open Government Licence for Crown copyright material unless otherwise indicated
sources.coverage_note: Only Ofgem-authored Crown-copyright text/data is reused; third-party material is excluded.

sources.name: NESO Existing Agreement Register
sources.coverage_note: NESO has a general Open Data Licence and publicly publishes the EA Register, but Grid Watch will not ingest this spreadsheet until the specific register's reuse licence is explicitly verified as compatible.

sources.name: Wales national planning applications
sources.coverage_note: No national, machine-readable planning-application feed with a clearly verified open licence has been identified. Grid Watch will not scrape or republish unlicensed council registers to fill this gap.

sources.name: Environment Agency — National Framework for Water Resources 2025, section 9.4
purpose: general water-resource context; no site or supplier matching
sources.coverage_note: Publication states England and Wales. Only Crown-authored text is summarised; third-party material is excluded. No site-level assessment is inferred.
